notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
The following issues have been addressed in this update:

-Fixed an issue related to Windows Language and Region settings that would cause blackouts or extended loading times.
-Fixed an issue preventing progress in the Ministry of Science route.
-Fixed an issue where toggling Vsync ON/OFF in the Options menu would still display as ON.
-Corrected several minor typographical errors in Japanese text.
-Revised the English translation for the Ministry of Health and certain other routes.

notes.title: Regarding a Bug Occurring with Save/Load in the Ministry of Science Route
notes.content:
We have confirmed an issue in the Ministry of Science route where saving and loading may not function properly.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may cause to our players.

[h3]Details of the Issue:[/h3]
When saving during the novel part and then loading again, players may sometimes be returned to the chart screen.
Depending on the save point, the scenario lock may not be lifted, resulting in the game progress getting blocked. (This does not occur for all players.)

We are currently investigating this issue and working to resolve it as quickly as possible.

[h3]Temporary Workaround:[/h3]
Please avoid saving during the novel part, and instead try saving after returning to the chart screen.
If the problem still persists, we kindly ask you to contact us via the support email address.

We sincerely apologize once again for the inconvenience, and we appreciate your continued support of SHUTEN ORDER.

notes.title: Regarding Issues Caused by Windows Language Settings
notes.content:
We have confirmed an issue where, if your Windows "Region and Language" setting is set to a language other than Japanese or English (Japan/United States), the game may experience black screens or significantly longer loading times. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may cause.

We’re working on a fix, a patch will be released at a later date.
In the meantime, you can temporarily avoid the issue by setting your Windows language to something other than the following:

Indonesian, German, Italian, Spanish, French, Dutch, Belgian, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Luxembourgish, Swiss, Greek, or Turkish.

We apologize again for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience until the patch is available.

notes.title: Cloud Save Support Announcement
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Shuten Order now supports Steam cloud saves.
By enabling Steam Cloud in your Steam settings, your save data will automatically be backed up going forward.

We are also reviewing the feedback we have received from players and will continue to consider improvements.
Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: SHUTEN ORDER Coming to Steam!
notes.content:
A brand new title from EXNOA, the company that operates DMM GAMES, and Kazutaka Kodaka of Tookyo Games, has been announced for a worldwide release on September 5.

Spike Chunsoft will be handling the publishing of the title as a digital exclusive for Steam and Nintendo Switch in North America and Europe.

SHUTEN ORDER is a multi-genre adventure game, that allows players to experience five different gameplay systems including, stealth action horror with multi-perspective visual novel elements.

[h3]SHUTEN ORDER Development Staff[/h3]
[list]
[*] Story: Kazutaka Kodaka, Takumi Nakazawa, Takekuni Kitayama
[*] Illustration: simadoriru
[*] Music: Masafumi Takada
[/list]

[h3]About SHUTEN ORDER[/h3]
"Happy New End...Have a good end"
"168 remaining until the end of the world..." Humanity is approaching its end.

In a world steeped in despair and chaos, a strange religious organization called Shuten Order emerges, yearning for the end of humanity. The group rapidly gains followers, eventually forming a small nation state called Shuten. Then one day, someone murders the Founder.

Following their death, the Founder is resurrected as Rei Shimobe (protagonist), by a miracle known as “the Power of God”. However, the resurrection is incomplete—their memories are gone, and their life limited to a mere four days.  

Two self-proclaimed "angels", God's messengers, arrive and declare to the protagonist that to achieve true resurrection, they must overcome "God's trial": identify and kill their murderer.  

Thus begins a high-stakes, four-day hunt for the truth, with their own life and the fate of the world at stake.
